repos_data.description: macOS companion toolkit for power users
Audit npm packages for security, maintenance, licenses and dependencies. Recommends install or write-from-scratch.
A macOS hotkey that opens your terminal at the right repo with your coding agent (Claude Code, Codex, …) already running. Free, open source, local-only.
Fast, opinionated AWS security scanner. Curated checks. Zero noise. Copy-paste fixes.
MCP Server for SecureCodeHQ. Lets Claude Code access your secrets securely.
An AI that administers Linux through typed, approval-gated, Ed25519-audited actions. The model selects the action; the daemon builds the command.
ClearanceKit intercepts file-system access events on macOS and enforces per-process access policies.
MCP security trust layer. Scan packages, get trust verdicts, check incident exposure, query abuse database. 5 tools, no API key needed.

Tamper-evident audit log for Go: an append-only, hash-chained, optionally Ed25519-signed log/slog handler, with offline logx verify. Built on the standard library, zero third-party dependencies. Also a full slog toolkit (colored output, JSON, rotation, fan-out, CLI).
Your Mac as a key fob: SSH keys that live in the Secure Enclave, open only the doors they're badged for, and take one touch to use.
Strict AI code reviewer MCP server powered by Groq
MCP server + CLI + Codex/Claude skill for embedded debugging via probe-rs or OpenOCD — ARM Cortex-M, RISC-V, and Xtensa (ESP32), with AI crash diagnosis
